title: CHI 2026 Connects Research on Aging, Privacy, and Interaction
summary: Returning to Houston, Park reflected on presentations, an award, and conversations across the HCI community.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Back in Houston after CHI 2026, Chorong Park reflected on a conference filled with workshops, paper and poster presentations, and conversations across the human-computer interaction community. Her April 21 post brings together research moments and informal exchanges in a 13-image gallery.

The week included recognition for the coauthored paper on robots and older adults' changing privacy boundaries. Purdue's conference report confirms the paper's Honorable Mention and places CHI 2026 in Barcelona, April 13-17.

For Park, discussions with people from different disciplines and countries were an important part of the experience. She connected those exchanges to questions about making technology more accessible, enjoyable, and responsive to aging populations.

Her reflection looks toward further work on sustainable robot adoption across the lifespan. She invited future collaboration across universities, departments, geographic boundaries, and industry, without announcing a new formal partnership.
